sampling.targetPopulation: Eight new diagnostic cases plus two explicitly labeled known regressions after v3 findings.
sampling.design: 8 holdout cases/12 turns;2 challenge regression cases/4 turns. Report split-specific metrics.
limitations: No suite can cover every adversarial input or all production users.
Known regressions are not held-out generalization evidence.
One model draw per case; semantic alias and source-label proxies are finite.
New count is too small to claim representative production accuracy.

goldPolicy.source: Human-authored expected outcomes and explicit synthetic metadata truth, independent of production validators and production check statuses.
goldPolicy.completeIntentMatch: Complete annotated intent match: every manually specified meaningful exact slot, scene/style concept, date range and clarification concept must match. Outcome status, dispatched-query relevance and preview success are scored separately. Annotation coverage is explicit per turn; this is not unlimited natural-language semantic accuracy.
goldPolicy.taskCompletion: All expected per-turn output and boundary criteria must pass. Unknown evidence is not completed.
goldPolicy.accuracy: Conservative gold-criterion accuracy includes unverified criteria in its denominator; observed-only accuracy and evidence coverage are reported separately.
goldPolicy.audioQuality: Not measured by this automated suite.
goldPolicy.toolQueryRelevance: Hand-authored synonym groups are checked against actually dispatched step input queries; artistOnly requiredArtist and release artist are legitimate tool search inputs. Never score unused brief/plans as dispatched queries.
